LESSON: NULLIFIERS OF SAUM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.4.1: Nullifiers of Saum

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Nullifiers of Saum. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should Muslims observe rules and regulation when fasting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum
2. practise saum as a pillar of Islam

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise saum as a pillar of Islam
   In simple words: practise until you can practise saum as a pillar of Islam. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Nullifiers of Saum using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Nullifiers of Saum in the examples.
2. Explain Nullifiers of Saum to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Nullifiers of Saum.
4. Show that you can: identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Nullifiers of Saum using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Nullifiers of Saum important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the nullifiers of saum and make presentation in class,
2. Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of creativity as learners sort nullifiers of saum from conditions of saum on flash cards.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should Muslims observe rules and regulation when fasting?
2. What virtues do Muslims learn from fasting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the nullifiers of saum to safeguard the validity of saum
2. practise saum as a pillar of Islam

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
